listing.name: Metroid Prime Remastered — Switch edition (MetroidPrimeRemasteredRecomp)
listing.summary: An early v0.1 Metroid Prime Remastered Switch-edition port. The project reports manual play from the opening Frigate to early Tallon/Chozo Ruins; loading all 275 areas is a separate test, rather than a playthrough. Vertical controller aim is broken, rare loading crashes remain, and physical controllers, HDR and real fullscreen are untested. The Windows x64 ZIP needs Windows 10 v1903+/11 and Vulkan 1.3; only RTX 3080 is tested, with AMD/Intel untested. The official launcher imports your own version 1.0.0 base NSP/XCI/NSZ/XCZ with prod.keys and title.keys where required; updates are not accepted. Those container formats were tested only with synthetic inputs. build_mpr.cmd separately translates source game code; player instructions do not establish whether translated code is already in the release. Exact title/region/hashes are unspecified, with no other desktop route established. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
